Package io.mavlink4j.service

package io.mavlink4j.service
L4 — one class per MAVLink microservice (command, parameter, heartbeat, manual control, message interval, capability). Depends on L0 and L3's ports, never on a concrete session.

Layer rule: a package never reaches two levels down; see docs/architecture.md.

    Command
    One MAVLink command to send through CommandService.send(io.mavlink4j.PeerId, io.mavlink4j.service.Command): which MavCmd, and its parameters, named instead of positional.
    Command.Positioned

    CommandResult
    A COMMAND_LONG/COMMAND_INT exchange's terminal result.
    CommandResult.Status
    How the exchange ended; CommandResult.Status.NO_ACK is silence, the rest map MAV_RESULT.
    CommandService
    MAVLink's command microservice (command protocol): COMMAND_LONG and COMMAND_INT, awaited as COMMAND_ACK matched on (origin sysid, command id) only.
    HeartbeatContent
    What our own periodic HEARTBEAT says about us.
    HeartbeatService
    MAVLink's heartbeat microservice (Family B — streaming, see docs/API.md): emits our own HEARTBEAT at a fixed rate, and tracks each known peer's connected/disconnected state against peerTimeout (convention "4-5 missed heartbeats" — not a spec number).
    ManualControlService
    MAVLink's manual-control microservice (Family B — streaming, see docs/API.md): a fixed-rate RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE (#70) relay, latest-wins mailbox, no acknowledgement at all, run on this module's own TxScheduler instead of a hand-rolled per-link thread.
    ManualControlService.ManualControlLink
    An opaque, engaged manual-control relay.
    MessageIntervalService
    MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL / MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE — both plain COMMAND_LONG exchanges, so this class is a thin, named convenience over CommandService rather than a service with any state or ack logic of its own: the ack cycle is implemented exactly once.
    ParameterOutcome
    A PARAM_REQUEST_READ or PARAM_SET exchange's terminal result.
    ParameterOutcome.Status
     
    ParameterService
    MAVLink's parameter microservice (parameter protocol): read a named parameter, and write one with a mandatory read-back.
    ParameterValue
    One aircraft parameter, exactly as the vehicle reported it in a PARAM_VALUE.
    RcChannels
    RC channel override values in microseconds, 1-based (index 0 is channel 1) — the payload ManualControlService relays as a MAVLink RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE (#70) frame.
    RequestResponse
    The shared Family-A state machine (see docs/API.md): send X, await a reply matching a MatchKey within a deadline, retry up to N times on silence, and let a reply itself decide whether the exchange is done or should keep waiting a bit longer without a resend.
    RequestResponse.AttemptPayload
    Builds the payload to send for a given 0-based attempt (0 = first send, 1.. = timeout retries).
    RequestResponse.ReplyClassifier
    Classifies a reply that matched the MatchKey: null means the reply is terminal (the exchange completes with it); a non-null, positive Duration means "keep waiting on the same key for this long, without resending" (Family-A's IN_PROGRESS-style continuation).
